name: Scanlix
author: scanlix

sections.description:
Make your WordPress site accessible to everyone—automatically.

Scanlix scans your pages for WCAG 2.2 violations using real browser rendering, not just static HTML checks. That means you catch screen reader issues, keyboard navigation problems, and dynamic content failures that matter to real users.

When issues are found, Scanlix doesn’t just report them—it generates ready-to-apply fixes using AI. Review the change in a clear diff view, apply it with one click, and roll back instantly if needed.

Why Scanlix?

Real Browser Scanning
Detects issues in dynamically rendered content, not just source HTML. Catches problems with JavaScript-heavy pages, Ajax content, and modern frameworks.

AI-Powered Fixes
Uses industry-leading AI to generate concrete solutions. See exactly what will change before you apply it.

One-Click Apply & Rollback
Apply fixes instantly or revert them just as fast. Every change is tracked and reversible.

Compliance Dashboard
Track your accessibility score over time. Filter by severity, WCAG criterion, or page. Perfect for teams working toward compliance deadlines.

Works with Any Theme or Page Builder
Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder—Scanlix works with all of them. No theme lock-in. No conflicts.

Multi-Site Support
Agencies can manage licenses across multiple client sites from a single account.

Standards & Legal Compliance

Scanlix helps you meet:
* ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act)
* Section 508 (U.S. federal accessibility standard)
* EN 301 549 (European accessibility standard)
* European Accessibility Act

WCAG 2.2 Level AA is the foundation for all of these regulations and is the recommended target for most organizations.

Pricing

Free Plan: 5 pages/month, 3 AI fixes/month
Lite: $19/year for hobbyists and small sites
Starter: $39/month for growing sites with more scanning needs
Premium plans: Higher limits, priority support, multi-site licenses

Start free, upgrade when you need more pages or fixes.

External Services & Data Processing

Scanlix connects to api.scanlix.app for scan processing and license validation. When you click “Generate Fix,” AI providers generate suggested code changes.

What data is sent:
* License key (for validation)
* Site URL and page URLs to scan
* HTML content of scanned pages (PII-scrubbed for AI processing)
* Issue detection results

When: Only when you click “Scan Now” or “Generate Fix”
Security: All connections use HTTPS encryption
Privacy: View our Privacy Policy
Terms: View our Terms of Service

AI providers may retain data for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring. We strip personal data from HTML before processing, but page content may incidentally contain author names or email addresses in HTML attributes or text.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

1. Scanlix API (api.scanlix.app)
* Purpose: Scan processing, license validation, fix generation coordination
* Data sent:
– License key (for validation)
– Site URL and page URLs to scan
– HTML content of scanned pages
– Issue detection results
* When: When you click “Scan Now” or “Generate Fix”
* Privacy Policy: https://scanlix.app/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://scanlix.app/terms

2. AI Providers (via Scanlix API)
* Purpose: AI-powered fix generation for accessibility issues
* Data sent: HTML snippets related to the specific issue (PII-scrubbed)
* When: Only when you click “Generate Fix” for a specific issue
* Data Retention: AI providers may retain data for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring unless a zero-data-retention agreement is in place
* Note: We strip personal data from HTML before processing, but page content may incidentally contain author names or email addresses in HTML attributes or text

All external service connections are encrypted (HTTPS). For detailed information on data processing, see our Privacy Policy at https://scanlix.app/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Scanlix plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through Plugins → Add New and search for “Scanlix”.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Scanlix in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your license key. Get a key at scanlix.app.
  5. Click Scan Now to run your first accessibility scan.
sections.faq:
What WCAG standards are checked?

Scanlix checks WCAG 2.2 Level A, AA, and AAA success criteria. You can filter scans by level (e.g., AA only for most compliance requirements) and view results by criterion.

Does it slow down my site?

No. Scanning runs on Scanlix cloud servers, not on your WordPress server. Your site’s performance is unaffected. The plugin adds minimal front-end code; the compliance badge (if enabled) is lightweight.

What themes does it support?

Scanlix works with any WordPress theme and popular page builders including Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Beaver Builder, and others. Scans use real browser rendering, so dynamic content is fully analyzed.

How does auto-fix work?

When an issue is found, Scanlix sends the relevant HTML snippet to an AI provider to generate a fix. You see a before/after diff, approve the change, and it’s applied to your content. You can roll back any fix instantly.

Is my data secure?

Only HTML snippets related to the reported issue are sent for fix generation. No personal data, user accounts, or sensitive content is transmitted. Scan processing happens on Scanlix servers with industry-standard security practices.

What’s included in the free plan?

The free plan includes 5 pages per month and 3 AI-generated fixes per month. You get full access to the dashboard, issue list, and compliance badge. Upgrade for more pages and unlimited fixes.

How do I upgrade?

Visit scanlix.app to choose a premium plan. Enter your new license key in Scanlix → Settings to activate the upgrade.

What happens if a fix breaks something?

Every fix can be rolled back with one click. Scanlix keeps a history of applied fixes so you can revert to the previous version at any time. We recommend reviewing each AI suggestion before applying.
